desc: Select the global edge-modulo characterization: in any valid decomposition, an edge is kept iff its side size is not divisible by K.

Implement and test the global edge-modulo check solution in Python: read N and K (M=NK), build adjacency, iteratively root the tree at 1 to obtain parent and order, compute subtree sizes bottom-up; for each v=2..M, add edge (v,parent[v]) to a kept adjacency iff sz[v] % K != 0; traverse kept components and print No if any component has size != K or any vertex has kept degree > 2, otherwise print Yes. Use iterative DFS, O(M) time/memory, and handle K=1 naturally.
